title: The plain bag, v
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Friday. The plain sack on the garage floor, the pup's head in it. Four panels of a dog eating from a bag with nothing on it. The strip's answer to a license: a paper sack.

panels.composition: The garage floor. The plain paper sack, open. BARNABY II approaching.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a plain brown paper sack open on a garage floor with a small three-legged dog approaching, no words

panels.composition: Head in the sack. The sack rustling.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small three-legged dog with its whole head inside a paper sack on a floor

panels.composition: Head out. Chewing. Sack tipped. Kibble on the concrete.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small dog chewing beside a tipped paper sack with kibble scattered on concrete, no words

panels.composition: The sack, flat, empty, plain. The dog asleep against it. Nothing printed anywhere in the panel. Nothing needs to be.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small three-legged dog asleep against a flattened plain paper sack on a garage floor, nothing printed anywhere, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: Wordless. A dog and a sack with nothing on it.
